## Common JOIN Patterns

### Campaign metadata enrichment（最常见）

```sql
WITH tag_selected_campaign_base AS (
    SELECT
        cast(grass_date AS DATE) AS grass_date,
        grass_region,
        campaign_id,
        business_tag
    FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.product_ads_business_tag
    WHERE cast(grass_date AS DATE) = DATE('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}')
      AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'TH', 'MY', 'VN', 'SG', 'PH', 'TW', 'BR')
      AND business_tag IN ('empty_order_expand', 'cold_start', 'npb')
),
ads_metadata_base AS (
    SELECT
        grass_date, grass_region, campaign_id, shop_id, item_id
    FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}')
      AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'TH', 'MY', 'VN', 'SG', 'PH', 'TW', 'BR')
      AND pricing_type IN (11, 15)
      AND placement IN (40, 50)
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
)
SELECT a.*, b.shop_id, b.item_id
FROM tag_selected_campaign_base a
LEFT JOIN ads_metadata_base b
  ON a.grass_date = b.grass_date
 AND a.grass_region = b.grass_region
 AND a.campaign_id = b.campaign_id
```

### Dim advertise JOIN（passrate 模式）

```sql
WITH campaign_base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cast(grass_date AS DATE) AS grass_date,
        grass_region, pricing_type, campaign_id, business_tag
    FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.product_ads_business_tag
    WHERE cast(grass_date AS DATE) = DATE('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}')
      AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'MY', 'VN', 'TH', 'PH', 'SG', 'TW')
      AND business_tag IN ('npb', 'cold_start', 'empty_order_expand')
),
ads_base AS (
    SELECT
        grass_region, grass_date, campaign_id, pricing_type, ads_id,
        shop_id, item_id,
        min(date(first_delivery_datetime)) AS ads_first_delivery_date
    FROM mp_paidads.dim_advertise__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}')
      AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'MY', 'VN', 'TH', 'PH', 'SG', 'TW')
      AND pricing_type IN (11, 15)
      AND placement IN (40, 50)
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7
)
SELECT a.grass_date, a.grass_region, a.campaign_id,
       b.pricing_type, a.business_tag AS item_type,
       b.ads_id, b.shop_id, b.item_id, b.ads_first_delivery_date
FROM campaign_base a
LEFT JOIN ads_base b
  ON a.grass_date = b.grass_date
 AND a.grass_region = b.grass_region
 AND a.campaign_id = b.campaign_id
 AND a.pricing_type = b.pricing_type
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### 1. 冷启动判定 (cold_start)

```sql
WITH campaign AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT grass_date, grass_region, campaign_id, pricing_type
    FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region IN ('BR')
      AND tz_type = 'local'
      AND pricing_type IN (24, 25, 27)
      AND campaign_status = 1
      AND (is_ads_active = 1 OR has_performance = 1)
      AND grass_date = date_add(current_date, -1)
      AND to_date(campaign_start_datetime, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') >= date_add(current_date, -8)
),
cold_start_ads AS (
    SELECT c.grass_date, c.grass_region, c.pricing_type, c.campaign_id
    FROM campaign c
    LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live p
      ON p.campaign_id = c.campaign_id AND p.grass_region = c.grass_region
     AND p.pricing_type = c.pricing_type AND p.tz_type = 'local'
     AND p.grass_date BETWEEN date_add(current_date, -8) AND date_add(current_date, -1)
    GROUP BY c.grass_date, c.grass_region, c.pricing_type, c.campaign_id
    HAVING SUM(COALESCE(p.broad_order_cnt, 0)) < 5
)
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mkplpaidads_search_ads.product_ads_business_tag
PARTITION (pricing_type, business_tag, grass_date, grass_region)
SELECT campaign_id, pricing_type, 'multi_item_cold_start' AS business_tag,
       grass_date, grass_region
FROM cold_start_ads
```

### 2. 空耗判定 (empty_order)

```sql
WITH campaign AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT grass_date, grass_region, pricing_type, campaign_id, ads_id
    FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region IN ('ID','TH','VN','MY','PH','TW','SG','BR')
      AND tz_type = 'local' AND pricing_type IN (11, 15)
      AND ads_status = 1 AND (is_ads_active = 1 OR has_performance = 1)
      AND grass_date = date_add(current_date, -1)
      AND to_date(ads_create_datetime, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') < date_add(current_date, -8)
),
empty_order_ads AS (
    SELECT c.grass_date, c.grass_region, c.pricing_type, c.campaign_id, c.ads_id
    FROM campaign c
    LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live p
      ON p.campaign_id = c.campaign_id AND p.grass_region = c.grass_region
     AND p.pricing_type = c.pricing_type AND p.tz_type = 'local'
     AND p.grass_date BETWEEN date_add(current_date, -7) AND date_add(current_date, -1)
    GROUP BY c.grass_date, c.grass_region, c.pricing_type, c.campaign_id, c.ads_id
    HAVING SUM(COALESCE(p.broad_order_cnt, 0)) <= 0
)
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mkplpaidads_search_ads.product_ads_business_tag
PARTITION (pricing_type, business_tag, grass_date, grass_region)
SELECT campaign_id, pricing_type, 'empty_order' AS business_tag, grass_date, grass_region
FROM empty_order_ads
```

### 3. 空耗承接期判定 (empty_order_expand)

```sql
WITH campaign_base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT grass_date, grass_region, ads_id, campaign_id, pricing_type
    FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region IN ('ID','TH','VN','MY','PH','TW','SG','BR')
      AND tz_type = 'local' AND pricing_type IN (11, 15)
      AND ads_status = 1 AND (is_ads_active = 1 OR has_performance = 1)
      AND grass_date = date_add(current_date, -1)
      AND to_date(ads_create_datetime) < date_add(current_date, -8)
),
perf_14d AS (
    SELECT p.grass_region, p.pricing_type, p.campaign_id, p.ads_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.grass_date >= date_add(current_date, -7)
                 THEN COALESCE(p.broad_order_cnt, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS recent_7d_orders,
        MIN(CASE WHEN p.broad_order_cnt > 0 THEN p.grass_date END) AS window_first_order_date,
        SUM(COALESCE(p.broad_order_cnt, 0)) AS window_total_orders
    FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live p
    JOIN campaign_base c
      ON p.campaign_id = c.campaign_id AND p.ads_id = c.ads_id
     AND p.grass_region = c.grass_region AND p.pricing_type = c.pricing_type
    WHERE p.tz_type = 'local'
      AND p.grass_date BETWEEN date_add(current_date, -14) AND date_add(current_date, -1)
    GROUP BY p.campaign_id, p.ads_id, p.grass_region, p.pricing_type
)
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mkplpaidads_search_ads.product_ads_business_tag
PARTITION (pricing_type, business_tag, grass_date, grass_region)
SELECT campaign_id, pricing_type, 'empty_order_expand' AS business_tag,
       grass_date, grass_region
FROM campaign_base c
JOIN perf_14d p
  ON c.campaign_id = p.campaign_id AND c.ads_id = p.ads_id
 AND c.grass_region = p.grass_region AND c.pricing_type = p.pricing_type
WHERE (COALESCE(p.recent_7d_orders, 0) = 0)
   OR (p.window_first_order_date IS NOT NULL
       AND p.window_first_order_date >= date_add(current_date, -7)
       AND p.window_total_orders < 3)
```

### 4. 新品判定 (npb)

```sql
WITH base_ads AS (
    SELECT grass_date, grass_region, ads_id, item_id, campaign_id, pricing_type
    FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region IN ('ID','TH','VN','MY','PH','TW','SG','BR')
      AND tz_type = 'local' AND pricing_type IN (11, 15)
      AND ads_status = 1 AND (is_ads_active = 1 OR has_performance = 1)
      AND grass_date = date_add(current_date, -1)
    GROUP BY grass_date, grass_region, ads_id, item_id, campaign_id, pricing_type
),
new_item AS (
    SELECT grass_date, grass_region, item_id
    FROM mp_paidads.ods_shopee_paidads_index_log
    WHERE grass_region IN ('ID','TH','VN','MY','PH','TW','SG','BR')
      AND tz_type = 'local' AND grass_date = date_add(current_date, -1)
      AND DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(item_create_time)) > date_add(current_date, -31)
    GROUP BY grass_date, grass_region, item_id
),
item_past_30d AS (
    SELECT grass_region, item_id, SUM(COALESCE(order_cnt, 0)) AS order_cnt
    FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region IN ('ID','TH','VN','MY','PH','TW','SG','BR')
      AND tz_type = 'local' AND ads_status = 1
      AND (is_ads_active = 1 OR has_performance = 1)
      AND grass_date BETWEEN date_add(current_date, -31) AND date_add(current_date, -1)
    GROUP BY grass_region, item_id
),
final_new_item AS (
    SELECT a.grass_date, a.grass_region, a.pricing_type, a.campaign_id
    FROM base_ads a
    JOIN new_item ni ON a.grass_region = ni.grass_region
     AND a.item_id = ni.item_id AND a.grass_date = ni.grass_date
    LEFT JOIN item_past_30d p
      ON a.grass_region = p.grass_region AND a.item_id = p.item_id
    WHERE p.order_cnt IS NULL OR p.order_cnt = 0
)
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mkplpaidads_search_ads.product_ads_business_tag
PARTITION (pricing_type, business_tag, grass_date, grass_region)
SELECT campaign_id, pricing_type, 'npb' AS business_tag, grass_date, grass_region
FROM final_new_item
```

### 5. 投放模式标签 (pricing_type_tag)

```sql
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mkplpaidads_search_ads.product_ads_business_tag
PARTITION (pricing_type, business_tag, grass_date, grass_region)
SELECT
    campaign_id, pricing_type,
    CASE
        WHEN pricing_type = 11 THEN 'target_roas2.0'
        WHEN pricing_type = 15 THEN 'simple2.0'
        WHEN pricing_type = 24 THEN 'gms'
        WHEN pricing_type = 25 THEN 'multi_product'
        WHEN pricing_type = 27 THEN 'gms_simple'
    END AS business_tag,
    grass_date, grass_region
FROM campaign
```
